items.title: Equable Analysis: State and Local Pension Funds Have at Least $578 Billion Invested in AI Companies
items.summary: State and local pension funds have between $578.1 billion and $706.6 billion invested in AI-related companies, according to an analysis released today by Equable Institute. This accounts for 9% to 11% of the total $6.42 trillion in state and local pension assets, as of June 30, 2026. Equable considers this range a conservative, lower-bound estimate.
